phases.name: Foundation
phases.description: Project setup, core infrastructure, database schema, authentication, and basic API scaffolding

phases.name: Core Features
phases.description: Timezone engine, task management with timezone awareness, team management, and the timezone overlap heatmap

phases.name: Collaboration
phases.description: Async handoff workflows, notification system with working-hours scheduling, and real-time presence via WebSocket

phases.name: Integration & Polish
phases.description: Slack integration, calendar sync, meeting scheduler, analytics dashboard, and end-to-end testing

tasks.title: Project Repository and CI Setup
tasks.description: Initialize monorepo structure with frontend and backend workspaces. Configure ESLint, Prettier, TypeScript, and GitHub Actions CI pipeline with lint, type-check, and test stages.

tasks.title: Database Schema and Migrations
tasks.description: Define the initial database schema for organizations, teams, members, tasks, handoffs, and meetings. Set up migration tooling and seed data scripts for development.

tasks.title: Authentication and Authorization
tasks.description: Implement JWT-based authentication with signup, login, token refresh, and password reset flows. Add workspace-scoped authorization middleware that ensures data isolation.

tasks.title: API Scaffolding and Middleware
tasks.description: Set up Express application with route organization, error handling middleware, request validation, logging, and CORS configuration. Create the health check endpoint.

tasks.title: Frontend Application Shell
tasks.description: Initialize the React application with routing, layout components (sidebar, header, content area), theme configuration, and the design system foundation. Implement responsive layout.

tasks.title: Timezone Calculation Engine
tasks.description: Build the core timezone module: overlap computation for N members, working hours validation, DST-aware date arithmetic, optimal meeting window calculation. Comprehensive unit test suite covering edge cases (half-hour offsets, DST transitions, date line crossing).

tasks.title: Team and Member Management API
tasks.description: CRUD endpoints for teams and members. Member profile includes timezone, working hours, and notification preferences. Team membership management with role-based access.

tasks.title: Timezone Overlap Heatmap
tasks.description: Frontend interactive heatmap component showing overlapping working hours across team members. Grouped by timezone. Click to see available members per time slot. Auto-updates on team composition changes.

tasks.title: Task Management API
tasks.description: Full task CRUD with timezone-aware features: deadline validation against assignee working hours, local time display, timezone-relative sorting. Task state machine (todo, in_progress, review, done).

tasks.title: Task Board UI
tasks.description: Kanban board with timezone context: assignee local time, time-to-deadline in assignee timezone, working-hours warning badges. Drag-and-drop status updates. Filter by assignee, priority, and timezone group.

tasks.title: Async Handoff Workflow Backend
tasks.description: API for creating handoff packages with structured summaries, linked tasks, and context notes. Handoff lifecycle management (draft, sent, viewed, acknowledged, completed). Scheduled delivery aligned to recipient working hours.

tasks.title: Handoff UI
tasks.description: Frontend for creating, viewing, and managing handoffs. Handoff creation form with task linking and context editor. Inbox view for received handoffs. Status tracking timeline.

tasks.title: Notification Service
tasks.description: Background job system for notification delivery. Working-hours-aware queuing: non-urgent notifications batched for delivery at recipient's working hours start. Urgent override capability. Support for in-app and email channels.

tasks.title: WebSocket Real-Time Presence
tasks.description: WebSocket server for live team member presence (online/offline/busy). Room-based broadcasting per team. Client-side reconnection with exponential backoff. Presence status displayed on team timezone map.

tasks.title: Slack Integration
tasks.description: Slack app with bot capabilities: post task updates to channels, create tasks from slash commands, query timezone overlap. OAuth installation flow. Channel-to-team mapping configuration.

tasks.title: Calendar Integration
tasks.description: Google Calendar and Outlook calendar read-only integration via OAuth. Sync free/busy data for scheduling optimization. Periodic background sync with conflict detection.

tasks.title: Smart Meeting Scheduler
tasks.description: Meeting time suggestion engine using timezone overlap data and calendar availability. Fairness scoring to track meeting time distribution across timezone groups. Frontend scheduling interface with participant availability visualization.

tasks.title: End-to-End Testing and QA
tasks.description: Comprehensive test suite: unit tests for timezone engine, integration tests for API endpoints, E2E tests for critical user flows (signup → create team → assign task → handoff). Load testing for WebSocket connections. Timezone edge case regression suite.

risk_areas: Timezone edge cases (DST transitions, political timezone changes, half-hour offsets) could introduce subtle bugs that erode user trust
WebSocket scaling with many concurrent team connections may require architectural changes earlier than planned
Third-party API rate limits on Google Calendar and Slack could impact sync reliability for large organizations
The timezone overlap computation becomes expensive for very large teams (200+ members) and may need caching or incremental updates
Handoff workflow complexity could expand significantly once real users provide feedback on edge cases (partial handoffs, rejected handoffs, multi-team handoffs)

phases.name: Setup
phases.description: Repository initialization, development environment, database design, and deployment pipeline

phases.name: Platform Core
phases.description: Authentication, team management, timezone engine, task management, and the primary UI components

phases.name: Async Workflows
phases.description: Handoff system, notification scheduling, real-time presence, and morning digest generation

phases.name: Launch Preparation
phases.description: Integrations, analytics, testing, documentation, and performance optimization

tasks.title: Development Environment and CI
tasks.description: Set up monorepo with pnpm workspaces. Docker Compose for local development (database, Redis). GitHub Actions CI with parallel lint, test, and build jobs.

tasks.title: Database Design and ORM Setup
tasks.description: Design and implement the database schema using Prisma. Create all models, relationships, and indexes. Write seed scripts for development data. Generate and test initial migration.

tasks.title: User Authentication System
tasks.description: JWT authentication with secure token handling. Registration, login, token refresh, and session management. Middleware for protected routes. Workspace-scoped authorization.

tasks.title: Team and Member Management
tasks.description: CRUD APIs for teams and members. Member profiles with timezone, working hours, and preferences. Team invitations and role management. Member search with timezone filtering.

tasks.title: Timezone Calculation Library
tasks.description: Core library for timezone operations: multi-member overlap calculation, working hours window computation, DST-aware scheduling, and timezone conversion utilities. Property-based tests for correctness.

tasks.title: Task Management System
tasks.description: Task CRUD with assignment, priorities, and status workflow. Timezone-aware deadline handling: warns on out-of-hours deadlines, shows local times per assignee. Bulk operations support.

tasks.title: Frontend Application Foundation
tasks.description: React app with routing, theme, layout system, and shared components. Design tokens for the visual style. Responsive sidebar navigation. API client with authentication handling.

tasks.title: Timezone Overlap Dashboard UI
tasks.description: Interactive timezone heatmap showing team availability windows. Member cards with local time and status. Timezone group clustering with visual overlap bands. Click-through to member details.

tasks.title: Task Board Interface
tasks.description: Kanban board with timezone annotations per card. Drag-and-drop task status updates. Assignee timezone indicators. Due date warnings for timezone conflicts. Responsive for tablet and desktop.

tasks.title: Async Handoff Engine
tasks.description: Backend service for handoff lifecycle: creation with structured context, scheduled delivery based on target timezone working hours, status tracking, and handoff history. Background job for timed delivery.

tasks.title: Handoff Interface
tasks.description: Handoff creation form with context editor and task linking. Handoff inbox showing received handoffs with status. Timeline view of handoff history. Acknowledgment and completion flows.

tasks.title: Working-Hours Notification System
tasks.description: Notification queue that respects recipient working hours. Urgent/non-urgent classification. Morning digest aggregation job. In-app notification center. Email delivery for offline users.

tasks.title: Real-Time Presence System
tasks.description: WebSocket server for live member status broadcasting. Automatic online/offline detection based on connection state. Heartbeat mechanism. Integration with the timezone dashboard for live status indicators.

tasks.title: Slack Integration
tasks.description: Slack app with slash commands for task creation and timezone queries. Channel notifications for task updates and handoff deliveries. OAuth installation flow. Workspace-to-team mapping.

tasks.title: Analytics and Metrics Dashboard
tasks.description: Collaboration health metrics: handoff turnaround time, cross-timezone response latency, meeting fairness score. Charts for timezone utilization trends. Exportable reports for team leads.

tasks.title: Testing and Quality Assurance
tasks.description: Unit tests for timezone library (including DST edge cases). API integration tests for all endpoints. E2E test suite for critical flows. Performance benchmarks for overlap calculation and WebSocket throughput.

risk_areas: Timezone library correctness is the single highest-risk component — a bug in overlap calculation undermines the entire product value
OAuth integration with Google Calendar and Slack requires handling token refresh, permission revocation, and API versioning
Real-time presence at scale may require dedicated WebSocket infrastructure earlier than anticipated
Morning digest generation must handle time-of-day edge cases: what if a user changes their timezone? What if working hours span midnight?
Database query performance for timezone-aware task listing may need query optimization or materialized views for teams with 100+ tasks
